description: Two ramp generators that also work as slew limiters, envelope followers and function generators, with a logic section combining the two

params.text: Picks the time range for that channel: Fast spans 1ms to 1 second, Medium spans 10ms to 10 seconds, and Slow spans 100ms to 100 seconds
Bends the slope of that channel, logarithmic counter-clockwise, straight at noon and exponential clockwise
Fires that channel's ramp by hand, one ramp per press
Sets how long that channel takes to rise, from the shortest time its RANGE switch allows through to 1024 times that
Sets how long that channel takes to fall, from the shortest time its RANGE switch allows through to 1024 times that
Makes that channel retrigger itself the moment it finishes falling, so it runs as an oscillator
Attenuates one ramp against the other before the comparator, MIN and MAX outputs: counter-clockwise lowers B, clockwise lowers A, and at noon both pass at full level

inputs.text: The signal that channel slews, its rise and fall times limiting how fast the output can follow it
A rising edge sends that channel's ramp to 10V and then back down; it reads high above 4V and low below 0.2V
Lengthens that channel's rise time, each volt doubling it, and is added to the RISE knob
Lengthens that channel's fall time, each volt doubling it, and is added to the FALL knob
Shortens both the rise and the fall time of that channel, each volt halving them
Switches cycling on for that channel while it stands at 4V or more, and is added to the CYCLE switch

outputs.text: A 10V gate for as long as that channel's output is climbing
A 10V gate for as long as that channel's output is dropping
A 1ms 10V pulse the moment that channel finishes falling
That channel's ramp, 0-10V, or its input signal slewed by the rise and fall times
10V while ramp B stands above ramp A and 0V otherwise, both taken after BALANCE
Whichever of the two ramps is lower at each moment, taken after BALANCE
Whichever of the two ramps is higher at each moment, taken after BALANCE
